summary: At exact candidate commit 399f520f72ea5ad85c33546a60c317f2c42759f8, DeepseekSparseAttnBackend copies the owning runner's KVIndexTranslator during construction. Independent failing-before/passing-after GPU tests verify the late-created EAGLE draft-extend backend and all multi-step draft-decode children, and an adversarial non-identity translator check verifies actual delegation rather than only static passthrough.

tests.what_was_measured: Independent reproduction on the recorded base: both late-created DSA shapes retained kv_index_translator=None. Raw output: reports/j-fc0804744b49/evidence/base-regression.log
Candidate regression passed: draft-extend and two draft-decode children share the runner translator, with non-empty prefix passthrough on a real FP8 DSA pool. Two tests passed.
Independent adversarial case: a non-identity recording translator was preserved by draft-extend and three draft-decode children and transformed GPU prefix IDs as expected.
Compatibility test was environment-blocked before backend construction: the optional deep_gemm symbol patched by the test was absent. This does not measure candidate behavior.
Candidate source and regression test syntax/import compilation.
Candidate-wide whitespace check found trailing whitespace only in committed raw pytest evidence logs, not in source or test code.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests ran on one assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. They allocated the repository's FP8 DSA token pool and CUDA tensors. See reports/j-fc0804744b49/evidence/base-import-gpu.log.

remaining_limitations: The reported four-GPU TP/EP GLM-5.3 EAGLE server workload was not run because only one GPU was assigned and GLM-5.3 weights/configuration were unavailable.

The single-GPU fixture verifies the backend lifecycle, translator identity/delegation, non-empty read indices, and FP8 DSA allocation; it does not qualify full-model semantic accuracy or distributed behavior.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The existing CUDA DSA indexer compatibility test was blocked before backend construction by a missing optional deep_gemm module attribute in the prepared environment.
Candidate-wide git diff --check reports trailing whitespace in committed raw pytest logs only.
